coverage.notes: cargo-llvm-cov/tarpaulin not installed; not installed for one run. Uncovered by design: CGEvent field reads in src/actor/mouse.rs:187-225 (need a live event tap).

findings.title: Leftover partial trackpad progress swallows an opposite mouse wheel notch
findings.impact: Violates plan criterion 3 (one notch = one column) after a partial swipe.
findings.suggestion: Reset scroll progress on Ended as well as Began (or before a discrete wheel step).

findings.title: scroll_sensitivity reaches handle_scroll_wheel without the validated() clamp
findings.impact: Negative sensitivity reverses trackpad and wheel; >100 lets 1pt of movement scroll up to 16 columns.
findings.suggestion: Use self.scroll_cfg (validated) inside handle_scroll_wheel instead of the raw config parameter.

findings.title: scroll_sensitivity = nan passes validation and silently disables scrolling (pre-existing)
findings.impact: No panic; wheel scrolling stays broken, trackpad until next Began.
findings.suggestion: Reject or default non-finite values in validated().

findings.title: Non-finite delta poisons scroll_progress for wheel events
findings.impact: Only reachable from edited traces; no panic.

findings.title: Began/Ended dropped when the modifier is not held
findings.impact: Pressing the modifier mid-gesture continues old leftover progress.
findings.suggestion: Forward phase-only resets regardless of modifier, or accept.

findings.title: Vertical swipe scrolls columns via delta_y fallback (documented in T1, out of scope)
findings.impact: Diagonal swipes add vertical movement to column scrolling.

findings.title: Smooth-scrolling mice report continuous events and get the pixel threshold
findings.impact: Such mice may need many notches per column.

next_action: Open F1 for findings 1-2 (reset on Ended; use validated scroll config in handle_scroll_wheel); merge test/R1-scroll with or after F1.
